messages:
incident-bot: Paging: HIGH traffic anomaly detected for /v1/embeddings-batch across edge us-east-1. spike_rate=28k/min, error_rate=0.9% :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): seeing the alert, I'm grabbing pager. Who's on embeddings infra?
Liam_SRE: it's me, looking at ingress. KV-cache hit rate dropped, lots of small requests (len<64). Could be scraping.
Tess_Product: any customer-facing impact yet?
Sam_Support: a few customers filed slow/429 reports, small subset of embed-heavy accounts. I have a list and will PM.
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable WAF bot block rule (sig-emb-scrape-v2) 2) apply per-token soft-rate-slice to anonymous API key tier 3) disable async batch embeddings for 15m as a failsafe. Can we deploy?
Liam_SRE: WAF rule cold deploy in edge config, rolling in ~30s. Applying now.
Kai_Eng: disabling async batch endpoint flagging: `feature.embeddings.async_batch = off` on prod. Doing a canary patch to router pool.
Maya (oncall): Sam, please prepare a short customer note template in case we need to announce degraded batch embeddings for 10-30m.
Sam_Support: drafting: "We detected abnormal automated traffic affecting embeddings; we've applied rate limits and temporarily disabled batch embeddings for some keys to protect service stability. If you're impacted, reply here and we'll prioritize"
Liam_SRE: WAF rule active at edge (rollout 12/12), initial telemetry shows drop in request fanout ~60%.
Kai_Eng: async batch flag toggled off across router fleet (3/3), requests now 1. single-request path handling only.
Maya (oncall): applying quota slice: reduce anon-tier burst to 50req/min and cap tokens/min to 200k for 30m. Liam, can you push the quota config?
Liam_SRE: pushing quota change via rate-limiter service: `rate_slice: {tier: anon, window: 60s, max_req:50, max_tokens:200000}` applied.
Tess_Product: do we have a rollback condition? If latency < 150ms P95 and error_rate < 0.1% for 10m, we step down mitigations.
Maya (oncall): agreed. Also leave WAF rule pinned for 30m to avoid oscillation.
Sam_Support: posting customer note in status page draft, will wait for final signoff before publish.
Liam_SRE: monitoring dashboards: p95 latency trending down from 420ms -> 160ms after quotas + WAF. Error rate moving to 0.12%.
Maya (oncall): good. Paging next shift: @Liam_SRE take lead for next 30m, I'll start formal incident doc. Kai, stay on-call for any rollback regressions. Sam, prepare proactive outreach for top 10 affected customers.
Liam_SRE: ack taking lead. Adding temporary alert `embeddings.edge.error_rate > 0.2% for 5m` to escalate to P1.
Kai_Eng: confirming no config drift on model-serving nodes. KV cache warmed back up after throttles, hit-rate improving.
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-3351000000-surge-sentinel. Incident severity: SEV-2.
Sam_Support: publishing internal note to CS and Support Ops with affected account list.
Maya (oncall): status update to execs: "Mitigations in place (WAF rule, quota slice, batch-disable). Observed stabilization; working on customer comms and 1-hour postmortem."
Tess_Product: tracking customer-impact metric: 12 accounts saw >30% degraded throughput, 3 accounts reported failed batch jobs.
Liam_SRE: after 18m, error_rate now 0.08%, p95 120ms. Recommend easing batch-disable to a staged re-enable for whitelisted customers first.
Kai_Eng: I can re-enable async_batch for whitelisted keys only. Will push a targeted rollout. Command: `feature.flag.enable(async_batch, include_keys=[...])`
Maya (oncall): go ahead with whitelist re-enable for 5 trusted customers while we monitor for 10m.
Sam_Support: notifying those 5 customers about test re-enable window.
Liam_SRE: whitelisted re-enable done, no regression in 12m.
Maya (oncall): metrics hold steady. Schedule: in 30m we'll gradually restore anon-tier quota to normal and remove WAF pin if stable.
incident-bot: Alert: `embeddings.edge.request_count` dropped 58% from peak after mitigations.
Tess_Product: do we know the actor? Any fingerprinting on UA/IP patterns?
Liam_SRE: initial sig shows high reuse of a small IP CIDR + rapid token churn, likely proxy farm. Added IP block list of 23.71.0.0/16 to WAF deny for the duration.
Kai_Eng: added request rate sampling logs to tracing for deeper forensics.
Sam_Support: published customer-facing status: "We applied protective measures; some batch jobs temporarily delayed. We're working to restore normal operation and will update." Posted on status.redwood.com/incidents/3351000000
Maya (oncall): time now +45m from start. Error_rate 0.05%, P95 110ms. I'm going to step down from lead to incident doc cleanup; Liam continue monitoring and escalate if flags fire.
Liam_SRE: will monitor. Leaving the quota slice for another 15m and WAF rule pinned until midnight UTC per Tess.
Tess_Product: agree to keep WAF pin until midnight UTC. Also start postmortem draft. Note action items: (1) tune anonymous tier heuristics, (2) add automated scraper signature detection, (3) consider short-circuiting batch on high-fanout signals.
Kai_Eng: forensic logs collected and uploaded to internal bucket `s3://rw-incident-logs/3351000000/` for research.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents and #eng-oncall.
Sam_Support: follow-up: 2 customers asked for credit for failed batch runs; CS queued for review.
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. final note before I drop: rotate incident to follow-up owner (Tess_Product) for postmortem; Liam keep monitoring until WAF unpin.
Tess_Product: taking postmortem ownership. I'll coordinate write-up and remediation tickets.
Liam_SRE: acknowledged. Leaving extra monitoring for 2h.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 3351004200. Severity downgraded to MONITOR.
